title: Where a conduit is broker- or issuer-mediated, Grove's outflow RateLimitID is absent and the inflow limit measures counterparty credit rather than venue exposure
content:
A.6.1.1.2.2.6.1.3.6.1.1 configures a Uniswap AUSD/USDC position on **Monad**, and its rate limit sections are titled "Deposit Rate Limits (**via FalconX**)" and "Withdrawal Rate Limits (via FalconX)" (.2.4.1, .2.4.2). Deposits are capped at 50,000,000 USDC with a 50,000,000 per day slope; withdrawals read `maxAmount`: N/A and `slope`: N/A; the outflow RateLimitID at .2.3.2 reads "N/A."

The same shape appeared in the USDC To USDG Via Paxos Instance, which has a single `transferAssets` limit and no outflow control at all. Two unrelated Instances, one an AMM position on a new chain and one a stablecoin mint, converge on the identical structure — which makes it a pattern rather than a quirk.

The common cause is that a rate limit can only constrain an action Grove itself takes on-chain. Where the outbound leg is a transfer to an intermediary — FalconX here, Paxos there — and the return leg is that intermediary performing an obligation, there is no Grove-initiated transaction on the return path to meter. The slot is not merely unset; it has no referent.

The consequence deserves stating without euphemism. For these Instances, `maxAmount` is not a bound on exposure to Uniswap or to Monad. It is a bound on how much **unsecured credit Grove can extend to the intermediary per day**. The named venue in the Instance title describes where the money is ultimately meant to go, not what Grove is actually exposed to while it is in transit.

So an "N/A" outflow RateLimitID is a reliable tell. Anywhere it appears alongside a populated inflow limit, the reader should look for an off-chain counterparty and reclassify the Instance's risk accordingly — the uniform schema will otherwise present it identically to a fully on-chain conduit.
description: The Monad Uniswap Instance routes deposits via FalconX with outflow RateLimitID N/A and withdrawal limits N/A, matching the Paxos conduit
